text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I spotted Taiki Shuttle and the others
in the pet section of the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Are you okay, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I am NOT okay, desu...!
Because it's just so cute...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't hold back any LONGER!!
I want a hug TOOO!"

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof woof! Grrrrr...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!? W-Why is that, pray tell?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?!
Ugh, uuu... Help meee~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I calmed down Taiki Shuttle,
who had suddenly burst into tears, and listened to what she had to say.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Puppy lets Suzuka hold him, but he won't let me hold him at all, yes...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haa... So sad. I want to be Suzuka too...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... er...
Well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. How do you think I can get Taiki to let me hold her?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Uuu... Trainer, please tell meee!
choice_data_list: Hold them firmly and without fear.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I see! Being too timid is a no-go, too, right! Okay, I'll give it a try!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Poppy! Look!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm your boss!!
Which means I am the law! That's the law of the wilderness!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So let ME give you a hug already!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It feels like a bit of an overkill, though.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof woof! Whine, whine...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The puppy is coming closer!
This is a sign to cuddle it, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You've got to be kidding me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The puppy has taken a liking to Taiki Shuttle.
It seems she's successfully
become the puppy's boss...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Because Taiki was nervous,
the doggy might've gotten nervous too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Okay, I got it!
Next time, I'll definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Taiki...! Aren't you being
a bit too relaxed...?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops! Sorry!
Suzuka, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Taiki Shuttle tried holding
the puppy once againâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whoaaaa...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's great, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! That's so cute!
Hawawa... Let me fluff it up one more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with the puppy
seemed to bring
Taiki Shuttle plenty of comfort and healing.
